title: MArch
description: This is a library mod required for my other mods to function properly.
body:
**This project is a lightweight Minecraft library mod designed to provide shared utilities, helper functions, and core systems for other mods. It does not add any standalone gameplay features on its own.**
###   Instead, it acts as a foundational framework that ot

![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc087e012b3f2305977b1632d0091b5dde271695.gif)

**🎨 Premium GUI & Aesthetics**

ArcBuilder moves beyond standard Minecraft menus to provide a truly premium interface:

**- 20+ Designer Themes:** Choose from a wide variety of presets including Glassmorphism, Dark Obsidian, Cyber Neon, Emerald, and Deep Sea.

**- Immersive Effects:** Interfaces feature animated background particles, theme-specific mouse cursors, and curated ambient audio tracks.

**- Centralized Mod Hub:** A unified "Mod Selector" screen allows you to manage all modules from one place, complete with search functionality and custom icons.

**- Favorites & Search:** Star your most-used configurations for instant access via the Favorites tab and find any setting quickly with the integrated search engine.
